fact: Afcom, per its own service page, operates a carrier-neutral data centre in Freetown where customers can rent rack, cage or space for their own servers or buy its cloud solution.
Afcom describes its Sierra Leone data center as a Tier III facility, concurrently maintainable, in its own words.
The Ministry of Finance's DFMST page says it operates a Tier III data centre providing co-location services for a number of institutions in Sierra Leone's financial sector.
